title: Customers quiet since mid June
statementMd:
List customers who have accounts but none of their accounts has a transaction dated on or after 2024-06-20. Show name.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts a JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE a.customer_id = c.id AND t.tx_date >= '2024-06-20');
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
